name: Banana Island Pool Villa
summary: A four-bedroom villa with a private pool, glass-walled living spaces and room for the whole family.
description: Crisp white architecture, a long private pool and indoor-outdoor living make this our most exclusive stay. Perfect for family holidays, milestone celebrations by arrangement, and executives who need space and privacy.

Glass-walled living space opening onto the pool terrace
Bedroom with a colourful artwork and orange upholstered stools
Living room with a grey sofa, fireplace wall and black chandelier
